purpose: Make the five Core5 Reality-era boards visibly distinct through ordinary-life systems rather than clothing, nostalgia, device or genre shorthand. This matrix is review support only and does not create Story Canon, exact historical years or literal family members.

eras.communication: paper records, handwritten notes and in-person coordination are ordinary system behavior
eras.movementNavigation: movement and shopping consume visible time; damaged or incomplete infrastructure can shape route choice
eras.shoppingAvailability: formal distribution, delayed supply and alternate acquisition routes can coexist without universal starvation imagery
eras.repairReplacement: repair, parts salvage, container reuse and continued use are default practical pressures before easy replacement
eras.paymentExchange: cash, coupons, ledgers or distribution access may matter, but exact system and exact year stay OPEN
eras.privacyRecords: paper records and local knowledge create access/privacy friction without modern-account assumptions
eras.householdAccess: different ages and household forms can have materially different food, transport, repair and distribution access
eras.ordinaryTaskFriction: waiting for people or supply, carrying goods, mending and maintaining tools materially change the day
eras.materialInfrastructure: repairable hardware, reused containers, paper systems and practical workshop/domestic traces must have use reasons

eras.communication: printed information, public signage, maps, timetables and institutional notices actively structure ordinary decisions
eras.movementNavigation: new roads, rail and development coexist with older paths; generations experience the changing network differently
eras.shoppingAvailability: processed foods and new household goods expand unevenly while price or energy pressure can remain visible
eras.repairReplacement: replacement availability grows but retained goods, maintenance and repair remain plausible and access-dependent
eras.paymentExchange: cash and physical transactions remain ordinary; exact payment details depend on the still-open exact year
eras.privacyRecords: school, workplace, civic and complaint systems leave paper/institutional traces rather than early-internet behavior
eras.householdAccess: prosperity, housing quality, pollution burden, transport and consumption differ across household and generation lenses
eras.ordinaryTaskFriction: route changes, price/energy constraints, environmental discomfort and institutional procedures affect daily planning
eras.materialInfrastructure: new-town, factory, road/rail, packaging and household-goods evidence must coexist with older built traces

eras.communication: feature phone, PHS, mobile mail, PC mail, BBS or personal-site culture may coexist without smartphone assumptions
eras.movementNavigation: printed directions and maps coexist with limited digital information; exact device/provider remains OPEN
eras.shoppingAvailability: cash, convenience-store access and growing abundance coexist without present-day delivery/app assumptions
eras.repairReplacement: chargers, cables, batteries, shared devices and dedicated storage create practical maintenance and access friction
eras.paymentExchange: cash and physical transactions remain normal; present-day QR/app payment must not leak backward
eras.privacyRecords: shared family PCs, handle names, forwarding/copying and screen privacy create household negotiation
eras.householdAccess: device ownership, connectivity and private screen access differ by age, income and household arrangement
eras.ordinaryTaskFriction: reply delay, waiting, finding printed directions, charging and shared-device scheduling are ordinary rather than failures
eras.materialInfrastructure: phone/key/cable/printed-direction storage and shared-PC layout must be physically plausible, not cyberpunk decoration

eras.communication: smartphone, group chat, cloud records and paper/legacy contact traces coexist as ordinary present-day behavior
eras.movementNavigation: 2026 Tokyo rail, smartphone navigation and local landmarks coexist without turning the board into UI screenshots
eras.shoppingAvailability: local shops, convenience, delivery and online purchasing coexist and remain uneven by household or mobility
eras.repairReplacement: easy replacement exists beside long-used personal objects, repair choices and attachment to familiar items
eras.paymentExchange: cash, IC and QR/app payment may coexist without implying universal cashlessness
eras.privacyRecords: cloud photos, group logs, recommendations, edited/fake images and provenance checking create ordinary information friction
eras.householdAccess: older and younger residents can use different mixtures of paper, cash, IC, apps and local support without caricature
eras.ordinaryTaskFriction: verification, delivery timing, account/device access, caregiving and mobility differences shape routine choices
eras.materialInfrastructure: current east-Tokyo streetscape and housing can retain older neighborhood traces without making Yui a retro character

eras.communication: identity-aware networks and multiple embodiment channels include ordinary offline, failure and access cases
eras.movementNavigation: mobility infrastructure must accommodate different body/device needs rather than assume one ideal human body
eras.shoppingAvailability: access and ownership rules matter more than decorative future storefront or hologram shorthand
eras.repairReplacement: maintenance, hardware generations, attachment to older body/device choices and replacement tradeoffs are normal life
eras.paymentExchange: service access, ownership and authorization rules are the meaningful axis; decorative future currency is not the era marker
eras.privacyRecords: body/account/person history can diverge, making authentication, continuity and personhood records daily infrastructure concerns
eras.householdAccess: human, Android/Robot/avatar and other embodiment needs can coexist within varied households without hierarchy or humanization pressure
eras.ordinaryTaskFriction: authentication failure, maintenance windows, access permissions and embodiment-specific environmental needs affect routine planning
eras.materialInfrastructure: credible service, repair, charging/interface and accessibility systems replace neon/chrome/circuit-body shorthand

humanReviewQuestions: Can each era be identified with clothing and character faces hidden?
Does each era use at least five ordinary-life systems rather than one hero prop or device?
Are generation and household differences visible without defining a Core5 literal family?
Are exact historical years still OPEN for Tomori, Michiru, Nagi and Asa?
Does Yui read as ordinary 2026 east-Tokyo life rather than smartphone-only or retro-Arakawa shorthand?
Does Asa read as a plausible social/maintenance/access system rather than generic cyberpunk future?
